t: 500ml car glass cleaner solution designed for maintaining a pristine finish on automotive glass. The powerful cleaner effortlessly removes dirt, grime, fingerprints, and smudges from vehicle windows and mirrors, ensuring a clear view for drivers. Ideal for professional valeting services and trade professionals managing fleet vehicles. The formula is safe for all glass types, including tinted windows, and can eal with tough spots without surface damage. Leaves glass surfaces crystal clear and streak-free, contributing to enhanced visibility and a professional finish.
